name: westwood_online_upgrade_progress_dialog_destructor
description: The implicit WestwoodOnlineUpgradeProgressDialog destructor directly delegates to the MFC CDialog destructor.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43f440 validates the compiler-generated implicit destructor as a direct tail jump to CDialog::~CDialog with the original progress-dialog object in ECX and no other side effects.
Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_progress_dialog_destructor_smoke patches the MFC CDialog destructor boundary and verifies that the implicit progress-dialog destructor delegates exactly once.
